Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_158531.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Read input: origen_158531.v · Open raw
module origen_158531(
    input inp,
    input clk,
    output reg encout,
    output reg decout
);

reg trig11, trig21, trig1, trig2, trig3, trig4, trig5, trig6, trig7;
reg [6:0] counter1, counter2;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    // Encoder logic
    if(counter1 == 7'd99) begin
        trig11 = ~trig11;
        counter1 = 7'd0;
    end else begin
        counter1 = counter1 + 7'd1;
    end

    if(inp) begin
        trig21 = ~trig11;
    end else begin
        trig21 = trig11;
    end

    encout = trig11 ^ trig21;

    // Decoder logic
    if(counter2 == 7'd69) begin
        trig3 = 1;
        counter2 = 7'd0;
    end else begin
        counter2 = counter2 + 7'd1;
    end

    if(trig3) begin
        if(encout) begin
            trig2 = ~trig1;
            trig7 = ~trig7;
        end else begin
            trig1 = ~trig2;
            trig6 = ~trig6;
        end
    end

    trig4 = trig5 ^ trig6 ^ trig7;

    if(trig4) begin
        trig3 = 1'b0;
        trig5 = 1'b0;
        trig6 = 1'b0;
        trig7 = 1'b0;
    end

    decout = trig1 ^ trig2;
end

endmodule
